description: This file defines an abstract generic repository class that provides common CRUD operations for managing entities using JPA's EntityManager. It is intended to be extended by concrete repository classes for specific entity types.

classes.name: Repository
classes.description: An abstract class providing generic CRUD operations for entity management using JPA.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Persists a new entity instance to the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merges the state of the given entity into the current persistence context.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the entity from the database.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds an entity by its identifier.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all entities of the specified type.
